messages:
Sam: Quick check — trying to finish onboarding zeta-mini v2. HF has the model but our mirror manifest missing. Where are the final S3 objects? Anyone on ingest today?
Marta: I uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta-mini/v2/manifest.json earlier but I saw presign errors last night. Might be ACL on staging-buckets.
Ingrid: Can you paste the expected checksum? I ran tokenizer smoke and saw pad-offset mismatch on the tokenizer.json.
James: From my local: manifest lists weights-0001.bin sha256:ab13c4d7e9b2... but the object in S3 has sha256:ab12f79a3d4e... so mismatch. Maybe multipart upload changed ETag vs sha256.
Sam: Reproducer: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta-mini/v2/weights-0001.bin - | sha256sum` -> ab12f79a3d4e... HF artifact shows ab13c4d7e9b2...
artifact-bot: ingest-service: ERROR checksum_mismatch: expected sha256:ab13c4d7e9b2 got sha256:ab12f79a3d4e on /zeta-mini/v2/weights-0001.bin
Marta: Uploader used the internal uploader which does multipart + on-the-fly chunking. I think we accidentally set checksum_algo=md5 in the tool config.
Ingrid: Also saw tokenizer.json had `pad_token_id: 0` — our loader expects `pad_token_id: -1` which causes pad-offset when tokenizing <|pad|>. That's an independent compat issue.
James: I opened PR #4589 to add `tokenizer_compat` and `checksum_algo` fields to the registry manifest. Adds lint check. @Sam @Marta PTAL.
Sam: CI failing on the ingest-lint job — timeout at 5m on presign+upload. We have presign TTL = 300s currently which is too short for large multipart from slower uploader nodes.
Marta: I'll bump presign TTL to 900s for the zeta-mini path temporarily and re-run. Also re-uploading weights with `checksum_algo=sha256`.
Harry: FYI infra: we need to know if this account will ingest >100GB so we can pre-allocate bandwidth/quota. @Marta can you add the size estimate to the ticket?
Marta: Yep, adding estimate and ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-899 — re-upload in progress :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Sam: Thanks. After re-upload and lint pass, can someone run `python tools/tokenizer_smoke.py --model zeta-mini/v2` and report pad offsets?
Ingrid: Will do once upload completes. Quick note: if we can't change pad_token_id now, loader can be patched with a compatibility shim.
James: Merged lint PR with small fix. Tests still flaky on CI; leaving comment in PR about presign TTL and multipart.
Marta: Uploaded. New object sha256:ab13c4d7e9b2... manifest updated and published. Re-triggering ingest.
artifact-bot: ingest-service: INFO ingest_started for zeta-mini/v2 by Marta
artifact-bot: ingest-service: INFO ingest_complete zeta-mini/v2 status=ok checksum=sha256:ab13c4d7e9b2 size=135GB
Sam: Awesome :tada: closing loop. Follow-up: we should add a brief doc about uploader config and checksum expectations.
